name: Shiso
description: Serrated aromatic leaf, green or purple, wrapped around sashimi and pickles.

tcm.note: Zi su ye is warm and releases the exterior; a standard drug for chills and for fish poisoning.

ayurveda.note: Katu and ushna by its aroma.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; aromatic leaves read as warming.

histamine.note: Very low — and classically given alongside raw fish for exactly the reason it is served with sashimi.

nutrition.highlight: served with raw fish, for a reason
